label: Faire
terms_note: Brand (wholesale seller) account on Faire; API key self-generated in Settings › Integrations; integration partners use OAuth 2 (authorization-code) and register an app; per-token rate limiting with 429; commercial terms are Faire's brand agreement (commission on wholesale orders) — the docs and help pages were bot-walled in this pass.

discovery.auth: token (brand API key generated in Faire › Settings › Integrations, sent as X-FAIRE-ACCESS-TOKEN) or OAuth 2 authorization-code for integration partners (X-FAIRE-APP-CREDENTIALS)

rate_limits: per-token throttling with HTTP 429 (numeric limit not stated); offset pagination beyond page 1 is rate limited, use the cursor

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **medium** — the official developer portal and help article returned a bo
auth: 1. Brand logs in to Faire → Settings › Integrations › Generate API key.
2. Send it as `X-FAIRE-ACCESS-TOKEN` on every call (single-brand use).
3. Multi-brand integration partners register an app and use OAuth 2 authorization-code (app credentials header) to obtain per-brand tokens.

endpoints.notes: wholesale price, retail price, options, images

reference.limits: Per-token throttle; honour 429 (third-party profile) — numeric limit not read. - Brand account required; API key is the brand's own. - Partner apps: OAuth 2 + app registration. - Commercial terms per Faire brand agreement (not read in this pass).
mcp_sdk: none official found in the pages opened

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Faire OAuth access token for the brand (Authorization Code Grant: POST https://www.faire.com/api/external-api-oauth2/token), sent as X-FAIRE-OAUTH-ACCESS-TOKEN. Scopes: READ_BRAND, READ_PRODUCTS, WRITE_PRODUCTS, READ_ORDERS, WRITE_ORDERS, WRITE_INVENTORIES.

fields.name: app_credentials
fields.help: Base64 of applicationId:applicationSecret from the Faire Developer Portal, sent as X-FAIRE-APP-CREDENTIALS (required together with the OAuth access token).

adapter.terms: Faire External API v2 (brands). OAuth tokens only work on External API V2+; both X-FAIRE-OAUTH-ACCESS-TOKEN and X-FAIRE-APP-CREDENTIALS are required on every call. Faire answers 429 when throttled.

me.note: GET /brands/profile: the brand of the current session {brand_id, name, currency, locale}.

update_listing.note: PATCH /products/{product_id} (listing_id = the product id, p_…) with name and description. `price` and `quantity` are ignored here: prices are per variant and region (PATCH /product-prices/by-skus) and stock is set with set_inventory.

end_listing.note: DELETE /products/{product_id}: sets the product's lifecycle_state to DELETED so it is no longer visible on Faire.

set_inventory.note: PATCH /product-inventory/by-skus {inventories: [{sku, on_hand_quantity}]} sets the on-hand units of one variant by its SKU (`sku` required; `listing_id` is ignored). All-or-nothing: an unknown SKU fails the request. Returns the resulting on_hand/committed/available quantities keyed by SKU.

list_orders.note: GET /orders?limit&cursor&updated_at_min, ascending by updated_at; pass next_cursor back as `cursor` (page numbers are not sent: Faire rate-limits offset paging). `since` = updated_at_min (ISO 8601). `status` is ignored (Faire only filters with excluded_states). state is NEW|PROCESSING|PRE_TRANSIT|IN_TRANSIT|DELIVERED|CANCELED|BACKORDERED|PENDING_RETAILER_CONFIRMATION; items, address and payout_costs are in raw.

mark_shipped.note: POST /orders/{order_id}/shipments {shipments: [{order_id, carrier, tracking_code, shipping_type: SHIP_ON_YOUR_OWN}]} adds a shipment and moves the order to PRE_TRANSIT (IN_TRANSIT once the carrier accepts it). carrier: CANADA_POST, DHL_ECOMMERCE, DHL_EXPRESS, FEDEX, PUROLATOR, UPS, USPS, POSTNL, CANPAR, INTERLINK_EXPRESS, GSO, ROYAL_MAIL, DPD, DPDUK, PARCELFORCE, AUSTRALIA_POST, EVRI, LA_POSTE (case-insensitive). The shipping cost (maker_cost) is not sent.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /products needs a taxonomy_type, variants with per-region prices (wholesale and retail), unit_multiplier and minimum_order_quantity to publish ('saved as a draft with publicationWarnings when it does not' meet Faire's publication requirements, https://developers.faire.com/docs#/paths/products/post); the vocabulary has one price and no category.
